per_row.answer: A customer must report a problem with a dairy item within **2 hours** of delivery. [1]
The return window for a frozen item is **4 hours** after delivery, and the **cold chain seal must be intact** at the time of the report. [3]
The return window for Personal Care products is **7 days** from delivery if the seal is unbroken. [1]
Refunds for UPI payments are credited within **24 hours** of approval. [1]
Card refunds are credited within **5 to 7 business days** of approval, subject to the issuing bank. [1]
Refunds under **INR 200** are auto‑approved without an agent review. [1]

The following items are never accepted for return:  
- Any item sold under a "Clearance" or "Near Expiry" tag.  
- Cut fruit, cut vegetables, and any repacked fresh produce.  
- Items where more than 30 percent of the pack has been consumed. [1]
A customer account may raise at most **4 approved perishable claims** in a rolling 30‑day window. [1]
Cash on delivery refunds are credited to the Nimbus Wallet within 24 hours, or to a bank account within 3 business days if the customer submits account details. [2]
No, a customer does not need to send a photograph when reporting a missing item. [1]
The promised ETA is composed of three components: **pick and pack time** at the dark store, **rider assignment time**, and **travel time** from the dark store to the delivery pincode. [1]
The maximum promised ETA for a serviceable pincode is **30 minutes**【2】.
The delivery fee is waived for orders of **INR 199 and above**【1】.
The delivery fee for an order below INR 199 is a flat INR 25. [1]
The handling fee for an order that contains a frozen item is **INR 10**【1】
Yes – a small‑cart fee of INR 15 applies to orders below INR 99, in addition to any delivery fee. [1]
The maximum surge fee that can be added during rain or peak hours is **INR 35** [1].

If an order arrives more than 10 minutes after the promised ETA, the customer is credited INR 50 to Nimbus Wallet automatically, with no need to contact support. The credit is issued once per order and does not apply to orders that were delayed because the customer was unreachable at the delivery address. [2]

Riders wait at the delivery address for up to **5 minutes**. After that the order is marked undelivered and returned to the dark store, and perishable items from an undelivered order are written off and are not restocked. [1]
No. Nimbus Now does not offer scheduled delivery; it serves only on‑demand orders【4】.

A pincode is serviceable when it lies within the service radius of at least one dark store that is open [1]. If a store’s operating hours have ended, the pincode can still be served by the nearest open store provided the 30‑minute ETA cap can be met; otherwise the pincode is treated as unserviceable until a store reopens [1].

A substitution is offered only when an ordered item is unavailable at the fulfilling dark store after the order has been accepted, and the customer is notified and given 90 seconds to accept or reject it before the order is packed without the item and the line is refunded【1】.
A substitute must be priced within 15 percent of the original line price [1].
No. A vegetarian item is never substituted with a non‑vegetarian item under any circumstance [1].
Baby Care items are never substituted because caregiver brand and formulation preferences in that category are not interchangeable, so the line is simply refunded [2].
Personal Care items may only be substituted when the replacement is the same product in a different pack size; they cannot be swapped for a different brand [1].

If no acceptable substitute exists, the line is cancelled and refunded, and the rest of the order proceeds. If that out‑of‑stock line represents more than 60 percent of the order value, the customer is asked whether to cancel the whole order. [1]
The operations targets are a substitution rate of **below 6 percent** of order lines and an out‑of‑stock rate of **below 4 percent** per dark store per day【1】.
No. A chilled item cannot be substituted with an ambient item because substitutions must match the storage class of the original item【2】.
Chilled items must be held between 2 and 6 degrees Celsius in a dark store【1】.
Frozen items are held at **minus 18 degrees Celsius or colder**【1】.
A chilled item that remains outside its required temperature range for more than 20 minutes must be written off and cannot be sold. [1]

Available units are calculated as the on‑hand units minus any units that are reserved for orders that have been accepted but not yet packed. An item is considered out of stock when its available units reach zero, even if there are still on‑hand units remaining【1】.
A dark store receives up to **two inbound trucks per day** [1].
The pick‑accuracy target is **99.2 percent**【1】, and each SKU is physically counted at least once every **14 days**【1】.

An item is given a **Near Expiry** tag when it is within 20 percent of the remaining shelf life [1].  
Consequences of the Near Expiry status are:

* The item is discounted [1].  
* Near Expiry items are **excluded from substitution** and **cannot be returned** [1][2].  
* They are also listed among the products that are never accepted for return, even if the normal return window is open [2].
A replenishment request is raised when the on‑hand units for a store‑SKU pair fall to or below its reorder point, and the request is placed for the next inbound truck slot [1].

Zestara Cold Brew Coffee 500 ml requires a chilled storage class【1】.
The stated shelf life of Ovenly Multigrain Bread 400 g is 4 days【1】.
No. Yolkwell Farm Eggs 12 pieces are listed with the dietary attribute “non‑vegetarian”【1】.

The substitute SKU listed for Frostbite Green Peas Frozen 1000 g is **QC-FROZEN-FROST-GREEN-PEAS-500**【1】.
No. Tinytots Baby Diapers Medium 32 pieces is excluded from substitution. [1]
The Annapurti Sona Masoori Rice 10 kg has a maximum retail price (MRP) of INR 760.00 and a current selling price of INR 668.80【1】.
Farmlyft Alphonso Mango 1000 g has a stated shelf life of **2 days**【1】 and it is listed as a **seasonal** product【1】.
No. The Silksoft Anti Dandruff Shampoo 340 ml is sold at its maximum retail price of INR 385.00, with no discount applied【1】.
Saket Dark Store serves the pincodes 110017, 110019, and 110048【1】.
The Rohini Dark Store has a service radius of 4.0 km [1] and operates from 07:00 to 22:30 local time [1].
The Powai Dark Store operates a rider pool of **11 riders** and its average pick‑and‑pack time is **7 minutes**【2】.
